Heat: HDR emission gain of the glowing cracks. Higher = brighter, blooms more.
Cooling: 0 = hot, 1 = cold. Higher narrows the cracks, lowers temperature and adds ash crust.
Crackwidth: Width of the glowing cracks. Higher = wider cracks.
Crackscale: Size scale of the crack network. Higher = more, smaller cells.
Flow: Strength of the flowing domain warp that bends the crack network.
Streaks: Strength of hot streaks flowing inside the cracks.
Pulse: Strength of the slow heat pulsing (two pulses per preview cycle). 0 = steady.
Crustbump: Strength of the relief (bump) on the cooled crust.
Glowtint: Tint multiplied into the emitted glow.
Envrot: Rotates the studio environment lighting around the vertical axis, as a 0-1 fraction of a turn.
Envint: Intensity of the procedural studio environment lighting.
Modamount: Scale of the in1 modulation CHOP. 0 = ignore it.
Speed: Animation speed multiplier for flow and cracks. 0 freezes.
Resolution: Output size in pixels of the internal preview render.
Bloom: Strength of the preview glow around bright cracks.
Spinturns: Whole turns the preview geometry rotates per preview cycle.
Tilt: Tilt of the preview torus knot in degrees.
Camdist: Preview camera distance in world units.
